- **NEW source-backed dangerous correctness bug found:** official pinned `GNOME/glib` tag `2.82.4` `gio/gwin32appinfo.c` `g_win32_app_info_dup()`, in supported-types deep copy: `for (i = 0; info->supported_types[i]; i++) break;` leaves i=0 whenever first type non-null. `g_new (gchar *, i + 1)` then allocates only **ONE pointer**; subsequent second loop writes every string pointer plus NUL, overflowing the buffer for any **nonempty supported_types vector**. This was also present in reviewed GLib 2.86.0, 2.90.0, and upstream main source at this date; not evidence of prior GNOME issue fix. `GAppInfoInterface.dup` actually points to this method; existing 8-cycle public GAppInfo CI did not exercise `g_app_info_dup()`. Unknown whether actual recording/GIO residual path invokes it. **Do NOT attribute the outstanding PrivateUsage accumulation to this newly discovered bug without callsite evidence.**
- **Exact disposable fix:** `tests/patch_glib_appinfo_dup_strv_ci.py` [03ff4c0](https://github.com/taku077/c545d-recorder/commit/03ff4c0daecbc885d4765957f9f211e7b8268d0f) replaces only the flawed two-loop allocation/copy block with `new_info->supported_types = g_strdupv (info->supported_types);`. GLib `g_strdupv()` guarantees deep copying the full NUL-terminated string vector (including empty case and terminator), and original `g_win32_app_info_finalize()` already calls `g_clear_pointer (&info->supported_types, g_strfreev)`; no need to alter ABI or public API. Fail-closed source patch rejects duplicate, nonmatching upstream, changed destructor, or repeated patch. [GLib reference](https://docs.gtk.org/glib/func.strdupv.html). This is **candidate code injected only into disposable CI GLib source**, not to any installed production recorder DLL.
- **Deterministic actual-GIO test, separate NON-RELEASABLE smoke hook:** `tests/patch_glib_appinfo_dup_vector_smoke_ci.py` [2606dd7](https://github.com/taku077/c545d-recorder/commit/2606dd7d60acae030d556a76c6a174e7ed5cf32a) adds environment-protected `C545D_CI_DUP_STRV_SMOKE` CI hook into disposable `g_app_info_get_all_impl()`.
